def polyfeat(cols,deg):
    out=[np.ones_like(t)]
    import itertools
    for d in range(1,deg+1):
        for combo in itertools.combinations_with_replacement(range(len(cols)),d):
            f=np.ones_like(t)
            for i in combo: f=f*cols[i]
            out.append(f)
    return np.column_stack(out)

def orth(Q,f):
    # project f onto complement of span(Q)
    if Q.shape[1]==0: return f
    c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(Q,f,rcond=None)
    return f-Q@c
def score_next(Q,r):
    # returns best improvement and index for each candidate using orthogonalized features
    if Q.shape[1]>0:
        Qo,_=np.linalg.qr(Q)
        Fo=F-Qo@(Qo.T@F)
        ro=r-Qo@(Qo.T@r)
    else:
        Fo=F; ro=r
    nrm=np.sum(Fo*Fo,axis=0)+1e-18
    gain=(Fo.T@ro)**2/nrm
    gain[nrm<1e-10]=0
    return gain
